content: Analyze the sequence of coordinates in the SVG path to identify patterns such as alternating directions, collinear points, or symmetrical arrangements that distinguish polygons with similar vertex counts. Then, determine if the shape is convex or concave by checking if all interior angles are less than 180 degrees (convex) or if any angle exceeds 180 degrees (concave). This distinction matters because certain shapes, like kites or irregular polygons, may have the same vertex count but differ in convexity, helping to narrow down the correct geometric option. For the example path, the vertices form a concave heptagon due to the inward indentation, confirming option (B) over other seven-sided shapes.
